svg.aria-label: Stacked horizontal bars of one decode token on the RTX A6000 running blocks 0 to 7 of the model, the median of 30 tokens in Nsight Systems traces. Stock, about 640 kernels: weight GEMVs 4.79 ms plus everything else 1.28 ms, 6.07 ms in all. Round 1, four fusions, 436 kernels: 4.81 plus 0.93, 5.74 ms, promoted. Round 2, three more, 363 kernels: 4.80 plus 0.75, 5.55 ms, not promoted. Everything else is small kernels, copies and the gaps between them; the GEMVs already read weights at 84 to 92 percent of the 768 GB/s peak.
